title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 2: David's last charge to Solomon and how Solomon's kingdom was established.

questions.text: What did David tell Solomon his son after saying, "I am going the way of all the earth"?
questions.explanation: David charged Solomon his son: "I am going the way of all the earth. You be strong therefore, and show yourself a man."

answers.text: "Be strong therefore, and show yourself a man"
"Rule them with a rod of iron"

questions.text: According to 1 Kings 2:5, which two captains of the armies of Israel did Joab kill?
questions.explanation: The verse speaks of what Joab did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, Abner the son of Ner and Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed.

questions.text: Whose sons were to be shown kindness and be among those who eat "at your table"?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 2:7 says to show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite and let them eat at your table, for they came when the speaker fled from Absalom.

answers.text: The sons of Ahithophel the Gilonite
The sons of Barzillai the Gileadite
The sons of Shimei the Benjamite
The sons of Abiathar the priest

questions.text: How many years did David reign in Hebron?
questions.explanation: David reigned forty years over Israel: seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: Whom did Bathsheba ask King Solomon to give to Adonijah as wife?
questions.explanation: Bathsheba went to king Solomon and said, "Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother as wife."

questions.text: Where did Bathsheba sit when she came to King Solomon?
questions.explanation: Solomon caused a throne to be set for the king's mother, and she sat on his right hand.

questions.text: Where did Solomon send Abiathar the priest?
questions.explanation: Solomon said to Abiathar, "Go to Anathoth, to your own fields," because he had carried the ark before David.

questions.text: Where did Joab flee when he heard the news?
questions.explanation: Joab fled to Yahweh's Tent and held onto the horns of the altar.

questions.text: Who was put over the army, while Zadok the priest was put in the place of Abiathar?
questions.explanation: The king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada over the army, and Zadok the priest in the place of Abiathar.

questions.text: Why did Shimei leave Jerusalem and go to Gath?
questions.explanation: Two of Shimei's slaves ran away to Achish king of Gath, so Shimei went to Gath and brought his slaves back.

answers.text: To visit his family in Bahurim
To bring back his runaway slaves
